description: HeRAMS Health Resources and Services Availability Monitoring System is published by World Health Organization. HeRAMS monitors essential health resources, service availability and barriers to service delivery in participating settings. Its stated coverage is Participating countries and emergency settings; health-facility observations. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider page describes access through its website or linked resources; the underlying files or applications were not downloaded or run. The inspected public resource is free to access. The inspected page does not state a reusable licence. Coverage and public access differ by implementation; operational dashboards were not entered. For simulation, it can inform health-service demand, capacity and disruption scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-simpy-streamlit-healthcare-des provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
